slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report of the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round; Lesotho appears only in the annex's score bands. On digitisation of the civil registration system it is listed in the 80-100 per cent band (one of five, with Rwanda, Tunisia, Uganda and Egypt); the composite score is not broken down by country, so no aspect value (events, how made, offices) can be read from it. Other bands for Lesotho: legal framework 50-64, infrastructure and resources under 35, planning and coordination under 35, overall 35-49.
